versions.changelog:
PhotoFresco 0.1.0 initial release:

- Edit photos in PhotoFresco, a professional browser-based image editor, via its MCP server.
- Supports layered editing, adjustment layers, non-destructive edits, masks, selections, filters, crop, resize, and PSD/PNG export.
- Users see all edits live in PhotoFresco, approve connections and permissions, and control file/folder access.
- Requires the PhotoFresco MCP server (Node.js 22+, browser installed), with clear setup instructions provided.
- Editing workflow supports history, undo, redo, adjustment parameter changes, and real-time previews.
